༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das rta mchog rol pa gnyen po lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs yang snying bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bcom ldan 'das rta mchog rol pa gnyen po lha bzhi'i sgrub thabs yang snying bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ha ya gṝ wa ya/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo/ bdag sogs 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar// bla ma rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi// gzhan don rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir// dbang chen lha tshogs bsgrub par sems bskyed do// mchod pa byin brlab ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong nyid dbyings las ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul// phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa yi// mchod pa'i bye brag nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐/ lha bskyed ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams thams cad skye med chos kyi dbyings// oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ khyab pa'i snying rje chen pos sems can don// dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ sems kyi mtshan nyid yi ge hūm̐ du gyur// badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐/ e yaṃ ra sha keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐/ hūm̐ las e 'phros gru gsum mthing nag e// hūm̐ las yaṃ 'phros rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng*// hūm̐ las ra 'phros khrag gi rgya mtshor gyur// hūm̐ las sha 'phros sha chen sa gzhir brdal// hūm̐ las keṃ 'phros rus pa'i ri rab brtsegs// hūm̐ las raṃ 'phros bskal pa'i me phung 'bar// hūm̐ las bh+rūm̐ 'phros bhan+dha'i gzhal yas khang*// chu srin sbrul chen ka gdung nya sbal thog /bya khyung bla bre sbrul phran za ra tshags// de dbus nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng na// gza' klu sa bdag pho mo bsnol mar bting*// bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dz+nyā na tsakra bh+rūm̐/ gdan steng hūm̐ babs de nyid hrīḥdamar po// yongs gyur dpal chen rta mgrin sku mdog dmar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro zhing rab tu gtum// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad// sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser 'bar// dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'tsher// phyag g.yas ral gri rtse la me 'bar 'phyar// g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub zhags pa bsnams// dur khrod chas brgyad sbrul chun rin chen spras// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dor stabs kyis// ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// dbu gtsug bya khyung rgyal po sku mdog nag

/rwa dang mchu sder sgro gshog rno zhing 'tsher// spyan gsum nyi zla lta bur gsal la 'khyil// rin chen sbrul rgyan phyag g.yas sbrul bzung za// rwa bar yid bzhin nor bu'i lto ba ru// pad zla'i gdan la bcom ldan tshe dpag med// dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis tshe bum 'dzin// gos dkar yum dang mnyam sbyor gnyis ka yang*// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas kyis rnam par brgyan// gtso bo'i thugs kar pad+ma nyi ma'i steng*// phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// mthing nag khro gtum g.yas pas rdo rje 'phyar// g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten rin chen sbrul// dur khrod rgyan rdzogs g.yon brkyang tshul gyis bzhugs// so so'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan// de las 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur// spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐/ dmigs med mkha' ltar khyab cing dag pa'i sku /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang*// thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos skur dag pa las// ye shes sgyu mar rol zhing gshegs su gsol// hrīḥ.a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na pad+ma kro dha ha ya grī ba badz+ra pā ṇi ga ru ḍaḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ e h+ye hi sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhrīṃ hrīṃḥdzaḥ sa ma ya ā be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha s+t+waṃ/ a ti pū hoḥ na ma hrīṃḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// thugs dam bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da sarba pū dza pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ mtshan tsam thos dang dran pa'i mod nyid la// 'chi bdag g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha// mi 'gyur tshe yi mchog sbyin legs stsol ba// bcom ldan gar gyi dbang por phyag 'tshal bstod// bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi gsung rdo rje'i// sgyu 'phrul 'gyur med rol pa rta mchog dpal// rgyal bsen la sogs lha srin sde brgyad kyi// gnyen po dbang chen dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ma lus pa'i// mdzod 'dzin phyag na rdo rje 'bar ba'i rwa// gdengs pa'i mod la gza' klu 'byung po'i tshogs// phye mar 'thag mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// mi bzad sder mos klu gnyan sa bdag gi

/don snying drangs nas zhal du gsol mdzad pa'i// dug lnga'i dbal kun yongs 'joms ga ru ḍaḥ bya khyung rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar nyi steng hrīḥmathar sngags phreng 'khor// 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus rang la thim// snang grags rig pa dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang*// dpal chen sku gsung thugs su 'grub par gyur// hrīḥ.a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na pad+ma kro dha ha ya gṝ ba badz+ra pā ṇi ga ru ḍaḥhūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces ci nus bzla/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal rten snying dang*/ sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ nyer bsdu dang thun mtshams kyi lha skur ldang ba ni/ snod bcud 'od zhu gzhal yas khang la thim// de nyid 'khor dang 'khor rnams gtso bor thim// de yang mi dmigs stong pa nyid kyi ngang*/ /slar yang dpal chen sku gsung thugs su gyur// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dbang chen lha tshogs 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa bya'o// zhes pa'ang gzhung rtsa ba las sbyor dngos rjes kyi yan lag mdor bsdus te mañdzu gho ṣas bris pa dge legs su gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga la bha ba tu/// /
